**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Mrs Moor](../persons.html#1044),
I am afraid Otterbourne will be unrepresented at [Ampfield](../others.html#124)[^1] on the 21st, as [Mamma](../persons.html#1606) and I are going on the 17th to London for a few days, chiefly to meet the Colbornes on their return from Ireland.[^2] I did not write before because our plans were not fully fixed.

We shall not be long gone, but it is a pity we just miss your celebration.

yours sincerely

CMYonge

[^1]: Ampfield was the neighbouring parish where Mrs Moor’s husband was perpetual curate.

[^2]: FMY\'s stepbrother [Lord Seaton](../persons.html#313) served as commander-in-chief of the army in Ireland 1855-1860.
